_note: Bulge kickoff post, written 26 Nov 2026 in the build sitting. Not a day record, so the site never shows it. Suggested time: Tue 15 Dec 2026, 6:00 p.m. Mountain, on X, Threads, Instagram and Facebook (as Pearl Harbor's). Image and scheduling still to do.
body:
Tomorrow at 6:30 a.m., a new Campaign Series begins: The Bulge, 16 December 1944 to 14 January 1945.

Thirty days, each posted on the date it happened, from the barrage in the Ardennes to the American armies closing on Houffalize.

Every morning's post is a clip from the Map Room: a plotting table of the whole battle, with wooden blocks pushed to where each division stood that night.

How to read it: olive blocks are American, khaki British, charcoal German. The red grease pencil line is the front each night. Black dashes are air missions. One block covers about 10 km.
